Rank genes by expression stability

Source: R/stability.R
housekeeping_stability.Rd

Ranks candidate reference genes with geNorm (Vandesompele et al. 2002) and NormFinder (Andersen et al. 2004), after keeping the genes detected in most samples. With group, NormFinder accounts for the groups, and a Kruskal-Wallis test tells whether each gene's expression differs between them, which makes a poor reference gene.

Usage

housekeeping_stability(x, genes = NULL, group = NULL, min_detection = 0.9)

Arguments

x

A nacho object from load_rcc() or normalise().

genes

The genes to rank; NULL ranks the Housekeeping probes.

group

A column of nacho_samples(x) with the biological groups, or NULL.

min_detection

The smallest share of samples in which a gene must be above background to be ranked.

Value

A list with ranking, a data frame with one row per gene from the most to the least stable: Name, CodeClass, detection_rate, mean_log2, geNorm_M, geNorm_rank, NormFinder_rho and, with group, group_p_value and group_p_adjusted (Benjamini-Hochberg); and pairwise_v, the geNorm pairwise variation V for each number of genes. A V below 0.15 is the usual sign that adding a gene no longer helps.

Details

The two most stable genes share the same geNorm M by construction, so their order, ranks 1 and 2, is arbitrary. Without group, NormFinder_rho is the standard deviation of the residual variation of the gene. With group, it also counts the variation between the groups, shrunk towards zero as NormFinder does.

Examples

data(GSE74821)
housekeeping_stability(GSE74821)$ranking
#>     Name    CodeClass detection_rate mean_log2  geNorm_M geNorm_rank
#> 1   PUM1 Housekeeping              1  9.706594 0.5939004           1
#> 2  SF3A1 Housekeeping              1 10.061556 0.5538149           2
#> 3 MRPL19 Housekeeping              1  9.656192 0.5740756           3
#> 4  PSMC4 Housekeeping              1 10.048324 0.6391309           4
#> 5   ACTB Housekeeping              1 17.201411 0.6534672           5
#> 6  RPLP0 Housekeeping              1 14.826392 0.7015339           6
#> 7   GUSB Housekeeping              1  9.701745 0.7443183           7
#> 8   TFRC Housekeeping              1  9.873900 0.8469462           8
#>   NormFinder_rho
#> 1      0.3618938
#> 2      0.2564156
#> 3      0.2979553
#> 4      0.4318650
#> 5      0.4470580
#> 6      0.5310189
#> 7      0.5975082
#> 8      0.7322992
